name: singbox-menu
title: Sing-box Menu
description: Menu bar controller for sing-box. Shows daemon status, lists JSON configs from a folder, switches the active profile.
author: kazelise

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Sing-box Status
commands.subtitle: sing-box
commands.description: Show sing-box daemon status in the menu bar and switch between configs.

preferences.name: configFolder
preferences.title: Config Folder
preferences.description: Folder scanned for sing-box JSON configs. Top-level *.json files and an optional 'profiles/' subfolder are listed.

preferences.name: singBoxBinary
preferences.title: sing-box Binary
preferences.description: Path to the sing-box executable. Leave blank to auto-detect from /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, /usr/bin.
